81597: Yukina Himeragi is the female protagonist of the series. She is an attack mage, or in the Lion King Organization, a Sword Shaman, who is sent by the Lion King Organization to observe the Fourth Primogenitor, Kojou Akatsuki.
87950: Kojou was a normal high school student 3 months ago, until the original 4th primogenitor had released her spirit into him because of a wish she had granted him. It's possible they made a deal. Sometimes, his vampire urges try to take over and his eyes are about to turn red.
87951: She is one of Kojou's classmates who works as a part-time computer programmer at the Security Department of "Itogami Island Management Corporation" in Level B.
87952: Astarte was a homunculus servant of Rudolf Eustach until Kojou and Yukina defeated him. Since then she has been sentenced to 3 years probation and is currently entrusted to Natsuki, who made Astarte her maid.
87953: Sayaka Kirasaka is a member of the Lion King Organization, which is assigned to the Multinational Magical Crimes under the Foreign Affairs Division. She is Dmitri Vatler's observer and is a "War Dancer" who specializes in using hexes and assassinations.
87954: Friend of Nagisa Akatsuki who goes to the same school as her and Yukina Himeragi.
87955: She is the princess of Aldegyr and the third person to make a blood pact with Koujo. She is related to Kanase Kanon, due to her grandfather having an affair.
87957: She is Kojou's younger sister and is also Yukina's classmate. She is usually chatty with people she likes and is a very good cook.
87958: Akatsuki Kojou's English teacher that claims to be 26 years old. She also assists Itogami Island Security with investigating crimes perpetrated by supernatural beings around Itogami Island.
87959: He is Kojou and Asagi's classmate. He is a member of the Far East District of the Lion-King Organization, and is the real observer of Kojou, the 4th progenitor, he is also Asagi's childhood friend and therefore often offers support to the latter for going after Kojou.
87960: The previous Fourth Progenitor, a young girl who passed her title to Kojou after her death.
87961: She is the 3rd leader of the Lion King Organization.
87964: An Artificial Intelligent software developed by Aiba, that she uses to either hack into secured firewalls or update her with anything that happens around the Island.

87968: An employee of Magnus Craft. She wields a spear containing the Familiar "Jabra." Though her immediate superior is Kensei Kanase, she is the one who is pulling all the strings because she happens to be the rainmaker in the organization.
226113: Aya Tokoyogi is the main antagonist of the _Fiesta For the Observers_ arc in the anime/light novel series Strike the Blood.
